statuses.match: Same name or value on both sides.
statuses.intentional: Differs on purpose; the reason comes from the decisions file.
statuses.gap: shadcn has it and DMF UI does not. M16 closes it.
statuses.differs: Both have it with different defaults. M16 matches it or records a decision.
statuses.extra: DMF UI has it and shadcn does not. Needs a decision: keep (intentional) or remove.

limits: Names are compared statically. Base UI sets some ARIA and data attributes at runtime; those appear only where shadcn styles them (stateHooks).
Variant axes are merged per family on both sides.
Rendered dimensions are measured by the shadcn-parity browser scenario and stored under `measured`.
